question: Which Minervini material was supplied, what is available today, what reached the contracts, and why is each rule not SOURCE_EXACT?

sources.title: Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard

droppedBefore7.reason: method context SEPA2018 (W-MIN18, the only English Minervini rows) was not mapped by the 2.0 extractor; fixed in 7.0

extraction.b03Note: B03 (272 pages, licensed translation) gave #709 only 8 rows, all PDF 193-232 (sizing, average loss, sell guides); 7.0 re-reading: 95 findings across the whole book

classes.SOURCE_PRESENT_ENGLISH: rule present in Minervini's own English words in the project (W-MIN18)
classes.SOURCE_PRESENT_TRANSLATION: rule fully present in the supplied books; only the English original wording is not in the project
classes.SOURCE_CONFLICT_TRANSLATION: the supplied translations / editions print different values; not a missing rule
classes.OPERATIONALIZATION_OPEN: rule present, but the books give no exact mathematical definition (a model assumption is needed)
classes.METHOD_DISCRETION: Minervini himself describes the step as judgment (manual), not as a fixed rule
classes.DATA_MISSING: the rule is clear; historical data are missing (independent of the books)
classes.PROJECT_AVAILABILITY: material that exists but is not accessible in the project
classes.ABSENT_FROM_MATERIAL: checked in every supplied book: the material contains no rule for it

MIN-SF-STAGGER.why: staggered stops redistribute, never increase the planned risk (English answer recorded by #709); SOURCE_DERIVED, because the wording is not re-verifiable here and no quote hash is held
W-MIN18 page not re-fetchable from the project (HTTP 403, archive unreachable)

MIN-SF-PRICE-CONFIRM.why: "confirming chart action" is broader than a pivot crossing; the machine part is derived

MIN-SF-PROCESS.why: Trend Template as the qualification; B12 and B03 both: a stock failing it is not considered

MIN-SF-TT-1.why: same numbers in B12 (2013, Indonesian) and B03 (2017, licensed Vietnamese): cross-translation consistent

MIN-SF-TT-3.why: at least 1 month, preferably 4-5 months in both books
no book defines how "trending up" is measured (21-session point comparison is the derivation)

MIN-SF-TT-6.why: B12 Trend Template 30 %, B03 25 %, B12 PDF 101 "at least 25 to 30 percent"; reference keeps 30 %, variant ALT-SEPA-TT6-25
intraday or closing 52-week low not stated

MIN-SF-TT-7.why: within 25 % of the 52-week high in both books
intraday or closing 52-week high not stated

MIN-SF-TT-8.why: IBD RS rating >= 70 is clear in both books; the rating is proprietary and has no history in the project
Minervini's own RS-line condition (not in a downtrend, preferably rising >= 6 weeks) is computable; variant ALT-SEPA-RS-LINE; no substitute for the rating

MIN-SF-PRIORITY.why: relative priority of the remaining names is a manual review in the book itself
surprise, revision and guidance history (inputs of the priority) have no PIT history in the project

MIN-SF-FUNDAMENTALS.why: no universal threshold: 20-25 % is a common minimum, higher in bull markets, single non-accelerating quarters tolerated
estimates, surprises, guidance; derived Q4 values not split-correctable (6.0: 405 cases)

MIN-SF-VCP.why: counts and halving are typical, flat bases allowed; validity is judged
footprint notation (6W 32/6 3T), depth bands (10-35 %, rarely after 60 %) and the flat-base bound (10-15 %) are printed, the contraction measurement is not; variant ALT-SEPA-FLAT-BASE

MIN-SF-PIVOT.why: buy over the pivot with rising volume, never before it, not chasing more than "a few percentage points" - no number for the chase or the volume
he waits for 5-20 cents over the pivot and says there is no magic number

MIN-SF-STOP.why: generally about 8-10 % as the maximum (STRONG_PREFERENCE), no volatility-widened stops (English answer)
absolute maximum 10 % in B12 / B07 / B03; cut at half the average gain
placement inside the bound (technical level vs percent) is the reviewer's; half-average-gain needs the trader's own history (diagnostic only)

MIN-SF-SIZE.why: pilot positions, progressive exposure, examples only (English)
risk per trade should not exceed 1.25-2.5 %, at most 25 % per position
the exact risk inside the range and the progression are the trader's

MIN-SF-SELL.why: selling is more subjective than buying (English)
concrete signals are printed (largest decline since the Stage 2 start, climax run, close below MA20 after a breakout, 2-6R sales) but not ranked into a rule set; diagnostic largestDeclineSignal

MIN-SF-PP-RUNUP.why: +100 % in under eight weeks on big volume, generally after dormancy (B12 / B03)
"big volume" at the start has no number (manual flag MIN-MR-PP-VOLUME)

MIN-SF-PP-CORRECTION.why: B03 clarifies the printed range: no more than 20 %, some low-priced stocks about 25 %
"low-priced" is not quantified; (20 %, 25 %] stays a review case

MIN-SF-PP-TIGHT.why: conflict resolved: B12 requires VCP characteristics, B03 exempts bases correcting no more than 10 % - exactly the reference reading

MIN-SF-PP-ENTRY.why: pivot of a power play not constructed in the books (run-up high is the model assumption)

MIN-SF-PP-SIZE.why: risk inside the range is the trader's

MA-MIN-MANUAL-SUBSTITUTE.why: the substituted decisions are manual in the books

MA-MIN-SEPA-SETUP-PROXY.why: VCP judged; flat bases allowed (B12 PDF 306 now gives their 10-15 % bound)

MA-MIN-STOP-PLACEMENT.why: stop inside the 10 % bound; half-average-gain rule needs own trade history

MA-MIN-ORDER-TYPE.why: no order type in the books; the limit follows the 10 % bound; chase limit only "a few percentage points"

MA-MIN-ENTRY-TIMING.why: buy intraday on price, judge volume by intraday extrapolation: needs intraday volume (not in the daily snapshot)

MA-MIN-INTRABAR-ORDER.why: order of high and low inside a daily bar is unknown without intraday data

MA-MIN-SETUP-VALIDITY.why: no setup lifetime in the books

MA-MIN-EXIT-POLICY.why: break-even at 2-3R (B12 PDF 410, B03 PDF 126: 3R raise, 2R break-even); sell rules judgment

MA-MIN-STAGE2-TREND-TEMPLATE.why: the Trend Template defines Stage 2 in the books themselves

MA-MIN-PP-ELIGIBLE-CLASSES.why: owner decision 2026-10-21: no automatic upgrade of manual setups

MA-MIN-RESEARCH-UNIVERSE.why: no fixed volume cutoff (English): the universe floor is a platform convention

MA-MIN-STOP-FILL.why: fill of a stop inside a daily bar needs intraday data

MA-MIN-MAX-POSITIONS.why: not more than 20 (B12), rarely more than 10-12 (B07); preference, not a cap

MA-MIN-RISK-FRACTION.why: B03: should not exceed 1.25-2.5 % per trade; reference 1.25 % is the lower printed bound
the value inside the range is the trader's

MA-MIN7-RS-LINE.why: RS line rising >= 6 weeks without a slope measure

MA-MIN7-STAGE2-START.why: start of the Stage 2 advance not dated mechanically

MA-MIN7-POST-BREAKOUT-WINDOW.why: right after the breakout has no number; 10 sessions from the printed 2-5 days to 1-2 weeks

MA-MIN7-WEEKLY-STEP.why: the weekly chart reading defines no week; 5-session steps from the entry, at least 4 prior weeks

MA-MIN7-AVG-GAIN.why: average gain of the trader's own history

MA-MIN7-EXIT-NOT-EVALUABLE.why: the books measure from the Stage 2 start and give no reading without one; REF exits are kept

MA-MIN7-EXIT-PRECEDENCE.why: research design (one-at-a-time): order of REF and variant exits on one close

MA-MIN7-EXIT-CATCH-UP.why: simulation convention for sessions without an executable open

MA-MIN7-CLIMAX-RUN.why: climax ranges printed (+25-50 % in 1-3 weeks, +70-80 % in 5-10 days), steepness without a measure; lower gain over the upper window end

MA-MIN7-CLIMAX-FRACTION.why: sell part or all into strength, no fraction printed; all

MA-MIN7-BASECOUNT-BASE.why: bases are counted in the books, not detected; 20 sessions is the printed lower end of a Stage 2 base (4-5 weeks)

MA-MIN7-BASECOUNT-MARKET-RESET.why: the count restarts after a market correction, whose size the books do not give; 10 % is a convention

MA-MIN7-BASECOUNT-STOCK-RESET.why: bases are counted inside one Stage 2 advance whose start is not dated; the 200-day line is the Trend Template boundary; without such a reset in the data the count is flagged uncertain with the direction of the possible error

MA-MIN7-BASECOUNT-CURRENT.why: base 1 is the first base after the reset; the setup counts its own base, a close on the setup session is never a completed base

MA-MIN7-TOPVOL.why: decline on the largest volume since the trend start: start of the trend and size of the decline not defined; two trend-start windows (Trend Template run, run above the 200-day mean) reported side by side, none chosen

MA-MIN7-RELDEPTH.why: two to three times the market correction, without a window, a price basis or a floor for the market decline; closes on both sides, two windows (same window, trailing high) reported side by side, none chosen

MA-MIN7-ENTRY-DISTANCE.why: no chase of more than a few percent (unquantified) and 5 / 10 / 20 cents over the pivot (no magic number): reported, not bounded; gaps read from the fill-bar open (limit fills included), non-executed orders counted only

MA-MIN7-CLIMAX-EXTENDED.why: 70 % up days in 7-15 days on an extended stock; extension not defined, second count inconsistent (translation doubt)

dataOnlyProblems.problem: PIT analyst estimates, revisions, surprise and guidance history
derived Q4 EPS not split-correctable (6.0: 405 SEPA entries with evidence); restatements not taken over
intraday volume and bar order (daily snapshot only; IEX intraday only from 2017 and only one venue)
undeclared corporate actions (V4-D1): SEPA 0 %, Power Play 0.99 % of reference trades directly exposed (6.0)
no untouched out-of-sample window before SF6-PAPER-2027

projectAvailability.item: English editions of Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard (2013), Momentum Masters (2015), Think & Trade Like a Champion (2017)
projectAvailability.note: only translations were supplied (Dropbox root, 13 PDFs, 2026-10-13); the books are complete, the original wording is not in the project

projectAvailability.item: Schwager, Stock Market Wizards (2001), Minervini chapter
projectAvailability.note: the supplied Schwager volumes are Market Wizards (1989), The New Market Wizards (1992, pt), Unknown Market Wizards (2020, fr): none contains a Minervini interview

disposition.F7-B03-041-011: IMPLEMENTED: postBreakoutEvidence healthy3of4 / healthy6of8 and longestUpRun over the first 10 sessions (G-UPDAYS, diagnostic)
disposition.F7-B03-047-015: IMPLEMENTED: postBreakoutEvidence lowerLowsOnVolume (volume above the 50-day mean reading) and lowerLowsCleared (third day closes up or in the upper half of its range on volume above the mean); the rising-volume-each-day reading is not computed (G-LOWERLOWS, diagnostic)
disposition.F7-B03-047-016: IMPLEMENTED as research variant EXIT-MA20-HALF (owner decision E7-7: pre-registered, SOURCE_DERIVED_RESEARCH_VARIANT, never a reference or original rule) besides the diagnostic closeBelowMa20InWindow
disposition.F7-B03-048-017: IMPLEMENTED: postBreakoutEvidence lowerLowsOnVolume, volume above the 50-day mean (diagnostic)
disposition.F7-B03-168-067: IMPLEMENTED: rsLineHighBeforePrice, price below its own 252-session high (at a setup the close is always below the pivot) (G-RSLINE-HIGH, evidence)
disposition.F7-B03-207-082: IMPLEMENTED: diagnostic baseCountAt (G-BASECOUNT, package 1.4.0) under MA-MIN7-BASECOUNT-BASE / -MARKET-RESET / -STOCK-RESET / -CURRENT; early (1-2), late (3-4) and likely-failure (>= 5) bases counted on the REF setups; no entry filter, no sell rule
disposition.F7-B03-211-084: DEFERRED: needs a PIT trailing-twelve-month EPS series; the derived Q4 values are not split-correctable in 405 cases (data quality); evidence only when that is solved; re-checked for 1.4.0: a subset without the derived Q4 values leaves a gap in every fiscal year, so TTM and rolling two-quarter series are not PIT-complete
disposition.F7-B03-212-085: IMPLEMENTED as research variant EXIT-CLIMAX (owner decision E7-7: pre-registered, MA-MIN7-CLIMAX-RUN / -FRACTION, never a reference or original rule)
disposition.F7-B03-216-086: IMPLEMENTED as research variant EXIT-CLIMAX-UPCLOSES (owner decision E7-7: pre-registered, translation doubt flagged, only the 70 % share used, MA-MIN7-CLIMAX-EXTENDED, never a reference or original rule)
disposition.F7-B03-217-087: IMPLEMENTED: diagnostic topVolumeDecline (G-TOPVOL, package 1.4.0, MA-MIN7-TOPVOL): first post-entry down close on the highest volume since the trend start, before the exit session, in two trend-start windows side by side (Trend Template run, run above the 200-day mean; none chosen); churning and the high-volume reversal stay QUALITATIVE
disposition.F7-B03-217-088: IMPLEMENTED: weeklyDeclineSignalBeforeExit, 5-session weeks anchored at the entry instead of Friday closes (MA-MIN7-WEEKLY-STEP, diagnostic); E7-7 research variants EXIT-LARGEST-DECLINE-WEEKLY and (with B12 PDF 130) EXIT-LARGEST-DECLINE-DAILY
disposition.F7-B03-225-092: IMPLEMENTED: diagnostic signalsByBaseNumber (package 1.4.0): the signals of EXIT-CLIMAX / EXIT-CLIMAX-UPCLOSES counted by the point-in-time base number of their trade; "the last base" of the paraphrase is known only in hindsight and is not mechanised; suppressing base-1 climax signals stays DEFERRED (it would change trades and rests on the base-count model assumptions; needs its own pre-registration)
disposition.F7-B07-032-109: DEFERRED: beginner sizing progression (equity +25 % / +50 % before larger positions) changes position sizes and reads the equity path (sealed metrics); not a rule for the reference account; owner may pre-register (re-checked for 1.4.0)
disposition.F7-B07-040-117: IMPLEMENTED: diagnostic entryDistanceTally.buyStopBuffer (package 1.4.0, MA-MIN7-ENTRY-DISTANCE): REF fills a buy stop 5 / 10 / 20 cents (raw dollars) over the pivot would not have triggered on the fill bar; the order variant stays DEFERRED (it changes fills; no magic number, F7-B07-040-119)
disposition.F7-B07-067-140: IMPLEMENTED: diagnostic entryDistanceTally.gapOpenAbovePivot (every REF fill whose fill-bar open is at or above the pivot, limit fills after the open included) / fillAbovePivot / ordersNotExecutedAboveLimit (package 1.4.0, MA-MIN7-ENTRY-DISTANCE, reporting buckets, no k chosen); the gap / chase-limit variant stays DEFERRED: a few percent is unquantified, any k is a model assumption that changes fills
